description: Some Tehran residents are welcoming the partial restoration of the internet in Iran. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian ordered authorities to restore internet access on Tuesday. description:
According to a report on Iranian state television, the memorandum of understanding being negotiated between Iran and the US will call for US military forces to withdraw from Iran’s vicinity and lift the blockade of Iranian ports in return for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz to pre-war levels. 

The White House pushed back on the Iranian state media report, calling it a “complete fabrication.” 

CNN’s Oren Liebermann breaks down the details and Iran analyst Ali Vaez explains how the potential deal would benefit both sides. 

0:00 CNN’s Oren Liebermann lays out details of a draft memo between US and Iran 
3:33 Iran expert identifies the memo’s key agreement between the US and Iran 
5:25 How would the nuclear issue be resolved if the draft memo is enacted? 
8:13 How would this deal be different than the 2015 Iran nuclear deal? 

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#Iran #Trump #News
title: Iran leaks peace draft details: What would US get for ending blockade?

description: The Dead Sea, the lowest point on earth, is dying. The intensely salty body of water - a huge tourist draw - has been shrinking at a rate of about four feet annually for decades. CNN’s Jeremy Diamond explores. #CNN #news
title: The dying Dead Sea: a man-made disaster

author: CNN
description:
Weeks after securing President Trump’s endorsement, Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton won the GOP Senate primary runoff.

After his loss, Paxton's primary opponent, Sen. John Cornyn, said he respect Texas voters’ decision and that he intends to support the Republican ticket in November, although he didn’t name his rival by name.

Meanwhile, the campaign arm for Senate Democrats said that Attorney General Ken Paxton’s win in the Texas Senate runoff puts them “one step closer to winning a Senate majority.”
